title: Conditions on Which Circumstance Surcharges Are Raised under Custom Application and Field Services
content:
Surcharges under Custom Application and Field Services pay for the circumstances a pass was run in rather than for the work itself.

**(a) Small acre.** The small acre surcharge is raised as a flat sum where the field is at or under the programme's threshold, because moving equipment costs the same whatever the field.

**(b) Point row.** The point row surcharge is raised as a percentage of the acre charge on irregular ground.

**(c) Out of window.** The out-of-window surcharge is raised as a percentage where the pass is run outside the plan's service window, the window running from the plan's window start through its window end with both days inside it.

**(d) Night and fly-on.** Night application and switching a ground pass to aerial each carry their own charge.

**(e) How they combine.** Surcharges of different classes add rather than the largest being taken, so a small irregular field worked after dark outside the window carries four of them.

**(f) Nil surcharges.** A surcharge the programme sets at zero is not raised at all and is not shown as a nil line.

**(g) Who moved the pass.** Where the cooperative moved the pass outside the window for its own scheduling reasons the out-of-window surcharge is waived, and where the member moved it the surcharge stands.

## Worked illustration on hypothetical figures

Suppose a hypothetical programme with a small acre threshold of 18 acres, a point row surcharge of 9 percent, an out-of-window surcharge of 11 percent and a night application surcharge of 110.00 USD, and suppose a flat small acre surcharge of 60.00 USD. A 12 acre irregular field is worked after dark, outside the plan's service window, and the acre charge on the work order comes to 148.00 USD.

| Class | Basis | Sum raised |
|---|---|---|
| Small acre | flat sum, the field being at or under the threshold of 18 acres | 60.00 USD |
| Point row | 9 percent of the acre charge of 148.00 USD | 13.32 USD |
| Out of window | 11 percent of the acre charge of 148.00 USD | 16.28 USD |
| Night application | flat sum | 110.00 USD |

The four classes add to 199.60 USD of surcharge on that work order. Had the same programme set its night application surcharge at zero, no night line would be raised and no nil line shown, and the remaining three classes would still add. Had the cooperative itself moved that pass outside the window for its own scheduling reasons, the out-of-window line would be waived while the other classes stood.
